site_name: The Steyne EstateSteyne RoadLondonW3 9NF
description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment (S96a) to planning permission ref: 223203FUL dated 09/02/2023 for: Construction of three  buildings, ranging in height from 4 to 20 storeys, to provide 188 mixed tenure residential units (Use Class C3) and ground floor community space (Use Class F2(b)); construction of a new one-way access road, new undercroft car park and landscaped podium to the car park; other landscape and public realm works; surface parking to accommodate existing car parking and blue badge parking and all other associated infrastructure works. (Regulation 3 Application by London Borough of Ealing). Amendment seeks confirmation of the increase to the building height due to the introduction of a lift overrun and smoke extract ventilation systems
